nodes.label: ChronoModels_vehicle library target
nodes.rationale: One monolithic target containing every concrete vehicle (jeep, bmw, gclass, hmmwv, feda, mtv, mrole, uaz, unimog, duro, generic, sedan, citybus, gator, m113, marder, man, artcar, kraz). ANCF/Reissner deformable tires and band-ANCF track assemblies are conditionally added only when CH_ENABLE_MODULE_FEA is on.

nodes.label: Vehicle subsystem file-group decomposition
nodes.rationale: Each vehicle is split into the same recurring subsystem groups - chassis, suspension, steering, driveline, brake, powertrain (engine + transmission), tire, wheel - mirrored both in directory layout and in source_group names. This uniform template is what lets templated vehicle models be swapped subsystem-by-subsystem across otherwise unrelated vehicles.
